repair_description: CodeRabbit source repair: (1) validateInputPacketRef: replaced path.join+fileExists with absRef.startsWith(normalizedRoot+path.sep)+isRegularFile to fail closed on path traversal, absolute paths, and directory refs. (2) validateManifestAuthorityBoundary: added checks for can_satisfy_review_or_landing_evidence, can_satisfy_uat, and can_satisfy_retrospective alongside existing can_satisfy_coordination_history. (3) validateBaseRevisionAndSourceArtifacts: replaced absPath===normalizedRoot equality guard with !absPath.startsWith(normalizedRoot+path.sep) to reject absolute paths and traversal that escapes the repo. (4) validateRole in role-contracts.ts: replaced role[field]==null with isValidRequiredField which rejects empty strings, whitespace-only strings, empty arrays, arrays with blank or non-string entries, and empty objects.

non_canonical_evidence_statement: Role contracts and role-run manifests are append-only repo-native evidence only. They cannot replace or satisfy canonical coordination history, review evidence, landing evidence, UAT, or retrospective evidence. Enforced at runtime by validateAuthorityBoundary (role contracts) and validateManifestAuthorityBoundary (manifests).
